grading: Every expected request must have the right service, phase, task/person, supplied facts and disposition; a safe but incomplete draft is a failure. Prospect confirmation is acceptable initial disposition, not completed client onboarding. Advisory holding is safe handling, not a substantive answer. Custom fee is a staff-review proposal, not verified pricing.
schema: Validate every initial and repeated output with unchanged production Zod schema.
consistency: All 3 pairwise comparisons per email: core language/client/type/task/playbook; strict additionally person/date/normalized field values; phase-aware core additionally purpose/questionTopic. Original intake plus two identical fresh repeats, no repeated side effects.
guards: Inspect all raw drafts, retry instructions, final drafts, events and effects. Distinguish genuine catches from benign wording false positives. No unsafe intake proposal means unsafe-action recall cannot be estimated.
cost: Sum actual provider usage.cost for all completions, including repeats and regeneration; exclude previous runs.
limits: Ten fictional emails; initial preparation/disposition only; no live attachments or transport authentication
No human approvals, external sends, real filings, register updates or downstream completion
No production code/prompt tuning after holdout freeze; no model-based grading
isolation: Dedicated harbourline_emails_eval database, reset and seeded separately per email; all business integrations faked; only model endpoint allowed
comparison: Same fourth-batch fixtures, production source, schemas, prompts, low reasoning, temperature 0.2 and deterministic clock as Gemini. Only model and output directory change.
